'''Tedesco''' (Japanese: '''カレント''' ''Current'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW125|Cilan and the Case of the Purrloin Witness!]]''. He is a special agent with the [[International Police]].

Tedesco first appeared spying on the cruise ship {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} were traveling on, when [[Mrs. Ripple]] invited them to her room to see her jewel collection. After that, while everyone was either watching or participating in the [[Marine Cup Tournament]] held aboard the ship, he was walking in the ship's hallways to find Mrs. Ripple's room. Tedesco carefully noticed Ripple's room guard {{p|Watchog}} in front of a door, thus locating the room.

After Cilan accused [[Teaque]] to be the thief of Mrs. Ripple's jewel, the "Eye of Liepard", he finally showed up in front of everybody when Teaque attempted to attack the entire group involved in the investigation with his {{p|Vanillite}}'s {{m|Blizzard}}. Tedesco stopped the attack by calling out his {{p|Growlithe}} and letting it use {{m|Flamethrower}}. It defeated both Vanillite and Teaque using {{m|Fire Fang}}. Mrs. Ripple's {{p|Purrloin}} recovered the jewel and removed Teaque's disguise, revealing that he was a wanted criminal who Tedesco was on the lookout for. He presented himself as an International Police member when {{OBP|Captain|Decolore Islands|the ship captain}} asked him who he was and it is assumed that he arrested Teaque off-screen.
